items.item_text: Licensure as a California Physical Therapist
Current BLS from AHA or ARC
More than 5 years of licensed PT experience qualifies for PT 2 title
Graduate of an accredited college or university with a bachelor’s degree or above in Physical Therapy

Seeking a Physical Therapist with strong background and clinical expertise in neurologic conditions, specifically with experience in evaluating patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).   Primary functions are to evaluation patients with ALS and provide recommendations including but not limited to equipment recommendations, activity modifications and caregiver education. Training with mobility device evaluation required.
